name: danielbodart-plugins
description: Security-focused Claude Code plugins for Linux desktop and web access control

plugins.name: graphical-sudo
plugins.description: Replaces sudo with pkexec for graphical authentication on Linux (GNOME/Cinnamon/GTK)

plugins.name: url-allowlist
plugins.description: Restricts WebFetch to URLs discovered via WebSearch, preventing arbitrary URL access

plugins.name: commit-push-trunk
plugins.description: Commit and push directly to trunk with linear history, supporting git worktrees

plugins.name: code-review-local
plugins.description: Code review local uncommitted or unpushed changes with multi-agent confidence scoring

plugins.name: web-researcher
plugins.description: Deep web research agent that finds and synthesizes information from multiple sources

plugins.name: notification-sound
plugins.description: Plays a notification sound when Claude has been waiting for your input for over a minute

plugins.name: statusline
plugins.description: A status line showing directory, git branch, context window usage, and Claude subscription quota (5-hour + weekly)
